subtitle: 寫信問教授能不能用舊版課本
task: You have just signed up for Professor Kim's Introduction to Psychology course. Write a short email to ask which textbook you need and whether an older edition is OK.
taskZh: 你剛選了 Kim 教授的「心理學導論」。寫一封簡短的 email，詢問需要哪一本課本，以及能不能用舊版。

en: My name is Jenny Huang, and I am in your Introduction to Psychology class this spring. I have a question about the textbook. The course page says we need the 5th edition, but my friend can give me her 4th edition for free.
Is it OK to use the older edition? If not, I will buy the new one this week. I just want to make sure before I start the first reading.
zh: 我是黃珍妮，這學期修您的「心理學導論」。我想請問關於課本的問題。課程網頁上說要用第 5 版，但我朋友可以免費把她的第 4 版給我。
請問用舊版可以嗎？如果不行，我這週就會買新版。我只是想在開始讀第一份指定閱讀前先確認一下。
